actions: DISPLAY 'BANKDATE: CANNOT OPEN FILES ' WS-IN-STATUS ' ' WS-OUT-STATUS

rules.sentence: When `WS-IN-STATUS` is not `'00'` or `WS-OUT-STATUS` is not `'00'`, it opens `CONTROL-IN` for input and `CONTROL-OUT` for output; displays `'BANKDATE: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-IN-STATUS` `' '` `WS-OUT-STATUS`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-IN-STATUS` is `'00'` and `WS-OUT-STATUS` is `'00'`; and reading `CONTROL-IN` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-IN` for input and `CONTROL-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-IN`; displays `'BANKDATE: NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-IN-STATUS` is `'00'` and `WS-OUT-STATUS` is `'00'`; and reading `CONTROL-IN` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-IN` for input and `CONTROL-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-IN`; performs `1000-NEXT-BUSINESS-DAY`; writes `CONTROL-OUT-RECORD` from `BANK-CONTROL-RECORD`; closes `CONTROL-IN` and `CONTROL-OUT`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 0; and stops the run.
